title: Foundation Drafter I/O
description: Input/output contract for function 122. SCOPE CUT (see dispatch.py's own module-section docstring): prompt.md names five foundation artefacts. This PR ships three -- brand and messaging constitution, metric definitions, approver map -- grounded entirely in docs/positioning.md, policies/autonomy-matrix.yaml and docs/permission-register.yaml, all real and already committed. It does NOT ship an ICP list (the 'weighted to platform-led conversions' cut needs real CRM/installed-base account data that is unprovisioned anywhere in this repo -- the same gap Fn 120 documents -- and fabricating 25-40 named target accounts would invent real prospective-client identities, which the corpus-evidence rule below exists to prevent) or quarterly objectives (needs Fn 38's three portfolio scenarios; Fn 38 does not exist in this repo, dispatch.py or otherwise). Self-gates quarterly per artefact via foundation_artefact_published signals -- the first run for an artefact always drafts it.

voice_profile.description: Fn 114's latest executive_voice_profile signal payload, or null if none has been published yet.

permission_register_summary.description: A short, real summary of docs/permission-register.yaml's default-deny policy and current entries, for the approver-map artefact.

cited_doc.description: The project doc this artefact was built from -- never authored from general knowledge.

artefacts.description: One entry per key in the input's due_artefacts, no more and no fewer.
